stem: In right triangle \(ABC\), what is the value of \(\cos B\)?
solution: For angle \(B\), the adjacent leg is \(BC = 8\) and the hypotenuse is \(AB = 17\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is adjacent over opposite, \(\frac{BC}{AC}\); cosine uses the hypotenuse in the denominator.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{AC}{AB}\), opposite over hypotenuse, which is \(\sin B\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{AB}{BC}\), the reciprocal of \(\cos B\).

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert d('A','C')==15 and d('B','C')==8 and d('A','B')==17 and abs(ang('A','C','B')-90)<0.1
ans=d('B','C')/d('A','B')
assert abs(cos(ang('A','B','C')*pi/180)-ans)<1e-3
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==Rational(8,17)
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
